dedupe_keys.name: a dataset to assess mobility changes in chile following local quarantines

description: A dataset to assess mobility changes in Chile following local quarantines is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Luca Pappalardo et al. Fighting the COVID-19 pandemic, most countries have implemented non-pharmaceutical interventions like wearing masks, physical distancing, lockdown, and travel restrictions. Because of their economic and logistical effects, tracking mobility changes during quarantines helps assess their efficacy and predict virus spread. Coverage: national (CL); published in 2023. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
